search_notes: Verified on 2026-10-02 UTC, corresponding to 2026-10-01 America/New_York; the 90-day cutoff was 2026-07-04 UTC. All nine repository entries were public, unarchived, and MIT- or Apache-2.0-licensed. Each was checked through gh api repos/OWNER/REPO and repos/OWNER/REPO/releases/latest, plus its upstream README. Entries with older releases or a latest-release HTTP 404 qualified through the cited default-branch commit. Discovery covered Claude-action and Codex-action repository names and descriptions mentioning both agents and GitHub Actions. Budget used: 30 GitHub API calls, including README/document API requests; 8 non-API page fetches; 4 web-search queries, which returned no usable results. Repository entries are ordered alphabetically by canonical repository URL, without ranking. PR/issue event wiring and least-privilege configuration remain caller responsibilities for configurable wrappers; multi-llm-security-review documents manual/reusable invocation and needs caller event wiring. The execution assumption is Ubuntu-family Linux CI runners accessible from the stated workstations; native self-hosted WSL2 and macOS arm64 execution was not tested. The direct-CLI baseline is an inference from the documented [Claude Code invocation model](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-base-action#trust-model) and [Codex CLI invocation](https://github.com/openai/codex-action#readme). Exhaustive coverage of every public fork is not established within the search budget.
